summary: v52cz rev2 — blank-form regen validated; DocSlot CORS fix verified; v52cz_downloads 6/6 still pass; however vendor BidSubmit bundle-picker is only partially implemented (critical gap vs spec).

ui_bugs.issue: Spec requires 'Download selected (N)' with per-row checkboxes defaulting to checked, a 'N of M selected' counter (data-testid=bid-docs-selected-count), 'All'/'None' bulk toggles (data-testid=bid-docs-select-all / bid-docs-select-none), and the download button must POST only selectedKeys and be disabled when 0 selected. Current code: button text is 'Download all ({docs.length})', hardcoded to send ALL docs.map(x=>x.key) regardless of selectedKeys; selectedKeys state exists but is never consumed by the download handler; checkboxes default to UNCHECKED (new Set()); counter/All/None controls and their testids are missing entirely. Grep confirms no occurrences of bid-docs-selected-count, bid-docs-select-all, bid-docs-select-none, or 'Download selected' in BidSubmit.jsx.

issues: Spec says the block should visibly show the filename 'PMC-Vendor-Registration-Form.pdf'; it only shows title + lede. template.file_name is fetched (meta API returns it) but never rendered. Minor UX miss.

action_items: BidSubmit.jsx: wire selectedKeys through to the download POST, change button label to 'Download selected ({selectedKeys.size})', disable when size==0, add data-testid=bid-docs-selected-count showing 'N of M selected', add 'All' and 'None' buttons with data-testid=bid-docs-select-all / bid-docs-select-none, and default every newly-uploaded doc key into selectedKeys (so initial state matches '2 of 2 selected').
RegistrationStart.jsx: render template.file_name next to the Download/View buttons so the vendor sees the canonical 'PMC-Vendor-Registration-Form.pdf' filename as the spec requires.
critical_code_review_comments: BidSubmit.jsx L420-442 — Download button ignores selectedKeys; selectedKeys is dead state. This is the exact bug the user complained about: vendor cannot bundle a subset of uploaded docs.

RegistrationStart.jsx L36-48 — fetchTemplateBlob uses credentials:'omit' which is correct for the public template endpoint; relative URL via vendorInviteApi.templateDownloadUrl() ('/api/v1/vendors/registration-template') confirmed CORS-safe for production bundles.
DocSlot.jsx L61-64 — viewUrl/downloadUrl are correctly relative '/api/v1/registrations/.../file?token=...' — baked-in REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL leak is fixed.

test_v52cz_blank_form.py — original raw-bytes grep assertions could not match because reportlab compresses content streams. Converted to pypdf text extraction (main agent's own note recommended this). All 3 blank-form tests now pass against live preview.

success_rate.frontend: 50% — blank-form Download works (PDF 6621 bytes, %PDF magic, filename PMC-Vendor-Registration-Form.pdf); DocSlot CORS fix verified by code; blank-form View fetch fires to the correct endpoint (window.open(blob:) suppressed by Playwright headless, works in real browsers); vendor bundle-picker UI missing required controls (see HIGH issue).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend blank-form endpoint returns a 3-page reportlab PDF — section headers decompose only via pypdf text extraction, NEVER raw-bytes grep (reportlab compresses the content stream). test_v52cz_blank_form.py has been updated to use pypdf and all 3 tests pass. The vendor bundle-picker spec in the review request (checkboxes default-checked, counter, All/None, Download selected (N), disabled at 0) is NOT yet implemented in /app/frontend/src/apps/vendor-portal/BidSubmit.jsx — only the checkbox markup + inert selectedKeys state exists. After main agent fixes BidSubmit, re-run frontend: vendor login → /vendor/bid/new/PMC-NOT-2026-0020 → upload 2 PDFs → verify counter reads '2 of 2 selected', toggle one checkbox → counter '1 of 2' and button text 'Download selected (1)', uncheck both → button disabled.
rca of the issue: Blank-form regression: previous test file compared marker substrings against raw PDF bytes (r.content.lower()). Reportlab emits compressed FlateDecode content streams, so section labels like 'Identity', 'Banking', 'Business Profile', 'Documents & Declarations' and schema labels never appear in raw bytes even though they render correctly on screen. Fix: use pypdf.PdfReader to extract page text, then substring-match. Content verified: all 5 section markers (Identity/Contact/Banking/Business Profile/Documents & Declarations) + all 5 schema labels (Legal Name/Primary Contact/Bank Account Number/Primary Sector/Incorporation Certificate) present; canonical filename + application/pdf content-type confirmed. BidSubmit picker gap: the main agent added the selectedKeys useState hook and per-row checkbox but did not refactor the download button (still consumes docs.map), did not add the counter/All/None controls, and left the default selection empty — so the UX contract in the review request ('2 of 2 selected', 'Download selected (N)', disabled at 0) cannot be met until BidSubmit.jsx L420-442 is rewritten to drive off selectedKeys.
